title: Studio
summary: Entry point for using, operating, and changing the local catalogue authoring app.
content_html:
Studio

Studio is the local catalogue authoring and maintenance app. Studio Overview gives the short capability, execution, authority, extension, and weak-spot model.

Use Studio

  • Catalogue Works — browse and open works.
  • Catalogue Work Editor — create and edit works and their detail sections.
  • Catalogue Series Editor — create and edit series and membership.
  • Catalogue Drafts — find incomplete and draft records.
  • Bulk Add Work — preview and apply workbook imports.
  • Catalogue Field Registry — review field definitions and build participation.
  • Tag Source Data — canonical tag data, services, and the five tag-management workflows.
  • Series Tags — review coverage and reconcile staged assignment sessions.
  • Series Tag Editor — edit one Series and its Work overrides.

Operate Studio

  • Local Studio App — server, runtime config, and sibling-service boundary.
  • Local Runners — start Studio alone or with the other local apps.
  • Config And Save Flow — browser reads, validated writes, and build follow-through.
  • Testing — choose focused service, route, or broader checks.

Change The Architecture

  • Studio Runtime — browser shell, route registry, templates, scripts, and ready-state execution.
  • Catalogue Architecture — canonical source and generated read-model boundaries.
  • Catalogue Services — mutation, transaction, build, lookup, and media-service boundaries.
  • Studio Domain Config — checked Catalogue and Tag policy.
  • Catalogue Media Pipeline Config — shared source-media and derivative policy.
  • Publish Media To R2 — confined remote media transport and confirmed versions.
  • Source Tree Ownership — Studio source, canonical data, generated data, public output, and local working boundaries.

Code Authority

Verify exact current behavior in:

  • studio/app/frontend/config/ and studio/app/server/studio/studio_app_config.py for route and runtime configuration
  • studio/app/frontend/ for the shell, templates, route scripts, and shared browser helpers
  • studio/app/server/studio/ for local HTTP routing plus catalogue and tag API adaptation
  • studio/services/catalogue/ and studio/services/tags/ for domain behavior and write authority
  • studio/data/config/, studio/data/canonical/, and studio/data/generated/ for config and data ownership
  • studio/tests/python/ for focused deterministic evidence
  • studio/tests/smoke/ for the three retained route-integration boundaries

Use code/config search for exact fields, routes, endpoints, or modules. Copying them into this page would make the entry point harder to trust.

Plan Studio Work

  • Roadmap — the shared app-roadmap, feature, concept, architecture, and delivery model.
